We never sell your data.\n Data is stored securely in Google Firebase (USA).\n Data may be shared with authorities if required by law.
You have the right to access, correct, delete, and export your data.\n You can exercise these rights from your profile or by contacting us.

• Data is stored in Google Firebase’s secure cloud infrastructure
 • All connections are encrypted (HTTPS)
 • Only authorized administrators have access to the data
 • Administrator activities are logged for security purposes
 • Automatic backup and redundancy are provided through Firebase
If you believe your data is mishandled, you can contact the Danish Data Protection Agency:\n www.datatilsynet.dk
